name: Windows — Scheduled Task Created with Suspicious Action
description:
Attacker objective
Create a scheduled task that runs attacker code for persistence or delayed/repeated execution.

Attack logic
Attackers register tasks that launch obfuscated PowerShell, scripting hosts, download cradles or binaries from user-writable paths, so the payload runs on a trigger or schedule.

Why this detection works
Scheduled-task-creation auditing (4698) records the full task definition; matching suspicious action/command patterns in the task content isolates malicious tasks, independent of case.

False positives
A legitimate administrative or software task that happens to invoke PowerShell with these arguments.

Tuning
Allowlist verified task authors/names; treat encoded/hidden/download tasks as high-risk.

Required telemetry
Windows Security 4698 (TaskName, TaskContent).
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. Read the task action/command and the author (SubjectUserName).
2. If the action is an encoded/hidden/download command, remove the task and investigate the author and host.
false_positives: A legitimate administrative or software task that happens to invoke PowerShell with these arguments.
query:
FROM logs-system.security-* METADATA _id, _index, _version
| WHERE event.code == "4698" AND winlog.event_data.TaskContent IS NOT NULL
| EVAL tc = TO_LOWER(winlog.event_data.TaskContent)
| WHERE (tc LIKE "*powershell*" AND (tc LIKE "*-enc*" OR tc LIKE "*frombase64*" OR tc LIKE "*downloadstring*" OR tc LIKE "*downloadfile*" OR tc LIKE "*invoke-expression*" OR tc LIKE "*webclient*" OR tc LIKE "*iex(*" OR tc LIKE "*iex *"))
   OR tc LIKE "*mshta*"
   OR (tc LIKE "*regsvr32*" AND tc LIKE "*scrobj*")
   OR (tc LIKE "*rundll32*" AND (tc LIKE "*javascript*" OR tc LIKE "*comsvcs*"))
   OR (tc LIKE "*certutil*" AND tc LIKE "*urlcache*")
   OR (tc LIKE "*bitsadmin*" AND tc LIKE "*transfer*")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, winlog.event_data.TaskName, winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName, winlog.event_data.TaskContent
